h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karnataka & Andhra Pradesh

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karnataka & Andhra Pradesh

items.pText: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to builders, schools, housing societies, resorts and municipal parks across Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. The two states cover very different ground, from Bengaluru's apartment towers and the wet Karnataka coast to the dry interior and the long Andhra coastline on the Bay of Bengal.

All our equipment is made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, with in-house design, roto-moulding and fabrication. We send it south by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it, self-standing or grouted. In Bengaluru most enquiries come from gated communities and schools. Mysuru, Mangaluru, Hubballi and Belagavi have schools and city parks. In Andhra Pradesh, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore and Tirupati have growing housing projects and schools. Send us the site size, the age group and photos, and we will draw a layout with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Mangaluru and the Karnataka coast get very heavy monsoon rain and salt air, so galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts are the safe choice there, with a well-drained base. Bengaluru's weather is mild, but sites are often small, so compact multi play systems work best. Mysuru and Hubballi sit inland and are drier than the coast, with hot summers before the monsoon. North Karnataka and the Rayalaseema region of Andhra are hot and dry, and shade over slides matters more than drainage. Visakhapatnam and the Andhra coast face cyclones, so grouted foundations are worth the extra effort.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which equipment suits a small apartment play area in Bengaluru?
items.a: A compact multi play system that combines slides, climbers and decks in one footprint, plus a swing or spring rider if space allows. Share the dimensions and we will show what fits on a layout drawing.

items.q: Is your equipment safe to install near the sea in Visakhapatnam or Mangaluru?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist rust in salt air. Rinse the equipment from time to time and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.

items.q: Do you install in smaller towns in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to towns across both states, and our team or a regional dealer installs the equipment.
